title: What Could Have Happened? A Mystery Explained

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Right. We have a mystery. The volleyball team's kit bag has disappeared. It was definitely here at 6 p.m. Now it's gone.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Who was the last person to see it?

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Rustam says he saw it at 6. After that, no one is sure.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Rustam must have been the last one out of the changing room. He usually locks up.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: He says he locked it. So the bag must have been taken before he locked up, or someone might have a spare key.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Could someone from the other team have taken it by mistake? They were here until 6:30.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: It's possible. Their bags are similar. They might have picked it up thinking it was theirs.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: But that can't be right — our bag has the WKU logo on it. They couldn't have confused it.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Unless they didn't look carefully. It could have been grabbed in a hurry.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Has anyone contacted their coach? He must know if extra equipment arrived with his team.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Not yet. But someone should have checked this hours ago. We should have reported it immediately when we noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: We needn't have wasted time speculating — we should have called the coach straight away.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Let's call now. He might still have the bag or might be able to ask his players.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: (Phone call) He says none of his players have it. They can't have taken it. They would have said something.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: So it must still be in the building somewhere. Someone must have moved it without realising.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: The caretaker! He's been cleaning all evening. He might have moved it to the storage room.

questions.text: "Rustam must have been the last one out." — "must have been" is:
opts: Past deduction (high certainty) based on evidence
questions.correct: Past deduction (high certainty) based on evidence
questions.hint: "must have + pp" = past deduction. Evidence: he usually locks up. Conclusion: he was last. ✅

questions.text: "They couldn't have confused it." — "couldn't have confused" means:

questions.correct: It's almost certain they didn't confuse it
questions.hint: "couldn't have + pp" = past deduction of impossibility. The evidence (logo) makes confusion almost certain NOT to have happened. ✅
